page.layout: One block of running text at full width, top of page; below it a small woodcut ornament (decoration, not text); at the foot a signature line at left and a signature at right.
page.running_head: De Morte & statu hominis post eam.

main_text.l: tim Scholasticis, omnem operam huc conferentibus, obtinuit tandem
superstitio & idololatria; quæ superiori quoque sæculo à Tridentino
Concilio roborata est. Quæ quum divinum honorem præcipue læ-
dat, primumque Decalogi præceptum impetat, alio loco examinanda
& confutanda erit. Sufficit hoc loco monere, præstare qualibuscun-
que illis circa mortuos officiis abstinere, & non nimis affectui indulgere;
istudque precum ac officiorum commercium, omnemque Sancto-
rum communionem, juxta Scripturam, non cum fato functis, sed
cum viventibus exercere; cum mortui partem inter viventes non am-
plius habeant, & alterius Ecclesiæ cives facti sint.

page.notes: Show-through and faint marks on the page were ignored. Some words in the first line are partly obscured by ink spread and are read as printed; "superstitio" and "idololatria" are as printed.
